events.verdict: Shannon Jr. (MIN) cleanly dislodges the ball away from Caruso (OKC) during his shot attempt near the basket.
Shannon Jr. (MIN) avoids stepping out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) rests a forearm against Reid's (MIN) body during the start of his upward shooting motion and the contact is marginal.
Shannon Jr. (MIN) grazes Caruso's (OKC) off-arm during the drive.
Shannon Jr. (MIN) jumps vertically and cleanly blocks Williams' (OKC) shot attempt near the basket.
Reid (MIN) legally contests Williams' (OKC) shot attempt near the basket.
Caruso (OKC) lowers his arm across Dillingham's (MIN) knee, but the contact does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Dort (OKC) moves laterally into McDaniels (MIN), initiating body contact that causes him to lose his balance.
The ball is last touched by Williams (OKC) prior to it going out of bounds.
Caruso (OKC) swipes down and initiates contact to McDaniels' (MIN) off-arm during his driving shot attempt that is more than marginal.
Clark (MIN) briefly grasps Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) jersey before releasing and Gilgeous-Alexander is able to move freely.
Clark (MIN) moves alongside Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) path to the basket and the body contact during his driving shot attempt is marginal.
Caruso (OKC) maintains a legal guarding position while defending Alexander-Walker (MIN) in transition.
Shannon Jr.'s (MIN) arms are not in a vertical position when he lowers them across Wiggins' (OKC) arms, affecting his shot attempt.
Wallace (OKC) is late to the spot when he initiates body contact to Reid (MIN) that affects his SQBR. The illegal body contact precedes Wallace making contact with the ball.
McDaniels (MIN) reaches in and any contact with Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) is marginal.
Reid (MIN) jumps alongside Caruso (OKC) during his driving shot attempt and the body contact is marginal.
Dort (OKC) cleanly blocks Reid's (MIN) driving shot attempt and the ensuing contact between the two players is incidental.
McDaniels (MIN) cleanly deflects the ball away from Dort (OKC) during his dribble.
Edwards (MIN) gathers the ball on his right foot and takes two steps before his jump shot attempt.
Wiggins (OKC) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) initiates contact with Reid's (MIN) arm, which affects his shot attempt near the basket.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) reaches in and the contact with Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) during his drive to the basket is marginal.
Edwards (MIN) cleanly blocks Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) driving shot attempt.
Edwards (MIN) makes contact with the ball before it enters the imaginary cylinder above the rim.
Minnesota signals for and is granted a timeout before Shannon Jr. (MIN) steps out of bounds.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) commits a take foul on Alexander-Walker (MIN).
Edwards (MIN) maintains a hand against Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) body during his jump shot attempt without applying force and the contact is marginal.
